title: Miso Sesame Shrimp with Edamame Slaw
description: Savory-sweet grilled shrimp over crunchy cabbage slaw with edamame and toasted almonds.
ingredients: 500 g jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Whisk the dressing ingredients, blend a portion with the miso, then marinate the shrimp 10 minutes.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, edamame and pepper with the remaining dressing.
Grill the shrimp 2-3 minutes per side, then plate over the slaw with almonds and scallions.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste miso shrimp salad

notes: The cabbage base stays crisp for 3+ days — keep the dressing separate if prepping ahead.
